lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Discourse\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
vendor/ ships 1 package that the server ships itself in a major of Nextcloud 32. Both copies define the same classes, and the autoloader that is asked first decides which version runs.
phpseclib/phpseclib 2.0.42, in 3rdparty/ of Nextcloud 32
1 use of the private API of the server in 1 file. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.
